---
title: "Molslinjen and Halfspace win the INFORMS Edelman Award"
date: 2024-04-15
description: "Forecasting and revenue management for fast ferries in Denmark."
---

The forecasting and revenue management toolbox that Halfspace and Molslinjen developed and deployed for the data-driven operation of ferries in Denmark won the 2024 INFORMS Franz Edelman Award.

The full story is in our paper [Data-driven at sea: Forecasting and revenue management at Molslinjen](../../../publications.qmd), published in the *INFORMS Journal on Applied Analytics*.
